brief: The canvas displays a perpetual, swirling vortex of semi-transparent characters, creating a fluid, constantly shifting field of text. When the viewer clicks the canvas, this amorphous stream momentarily organizes itself. The characters rapidly coalesce, snapping into fully legible, linear lines of text that briefly achieve a high-contrast luminosity, reminiscent of old newsprint. This structured moment of clarity is fleeting; the legible lines visibly scatter, dissolving into smaller, fading fragments that dissipate back into the underlying, flowing textual cloud.

statement: This sketch creates a dynamic visual metaphor for information flow and organization. Characters swirl in a perpetual vortex of semi-transparent text, representing the constant stream of data that surrounds us. When clicked, this fluid field momentarily organizes itself into legible lines of text, creating a fleeting moment of clarity reminiscent of newsprint. The effect is both a visual representation of how we make sense of information and a poetic meditation on the ephemeral nature of understanding. The characters dissolve back into their flowing state after the structured moment, suggesting that order is temporary while chaos persists.
